properties.name: Netcraft Domain Detection - Newly registered high risk
properties.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where tostring(Tags) contains "Newly Registered (24h)"
| extend
    DNSDomain = Hostname,
    RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| where RiskCategory in ("highest", "high")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    DomainResultId,
    Subject,
    Hostname,
    DNSDomain,
    Risk,
    RiskCategory,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType,
    Tags,
    IpAddresses,
    Registrar,
    Domain,
    AreaId
properties.description:
Identifies Domain Detection results whose tag `display_name` is `Newly Registered (24h)` with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest so the same DomainResultId alerts once per window.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Domain {{Hostname}} ({{DomainResultId}}) is tagged Newly Registered (24h) with risk {{RiskCategory}}.
